slice: R.243 Admin Read Model Projection Readiness
phase: Phase 3 Admin Read Model and Query API observability
full_goal_statement: This advances Admin Architecture v1 by making read-model projection availability explicit. It does not rebuild the material-summary projection, complete Protection Gate coverage, route-loader restructuring, UI information architecture, redundancy cleanup, Docker release gates, or the full Admin Architecture v1 goal.

role_review.project_architect: approved: the slice distinguishes store freshness from projection readiness without downgrading usable route read-model paths.
role_review.delivery_lead: approved: the change is read-only/status/reporting behavior plus tests; it does not write NAS data, start reconcile, or alter Cutter protocols.

summary: Admin read-model status now exposes optional projections.material_summary and projections.production_summary readiness.
Projection readiness records status, reason, scan_mode, requires_background_reconcile, safe_for_page_request, video_count, and current_video_count.
The main store freshness and reconciliation plan remain page-safe when counts are fresh; projection gaps are visible without marking the whole store stale.
The real NAS performance report now includes a Read Model Projection Readiness table.

verification.redundancy_audit_note: The audit command exited successfully and preserved the governance state: cleanup remains blocked until candidates are reviewed.

remaining_gaps: The material-summary projection still needs a controlled maintenance rebuild to populate dashboard_material_* metadata.
The observed source_video_status table is fresh for counts but only has 939 full manifest rows, so it cannot support full material duration/size aggregation yet.
Route-loader restructuring, UI information architecture, Protection Gate completion, redundancy cleanup, Docker release gates, and full Admin Architecture v1 remain incomplete.
